<function name="GetNetworkedVarTable" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
<deprecated>You should be using <page>Entity:GetNWVarTable</page> instead.</deprecated>

Returns all the networked variables in an entity.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table<string,any>">Key-Value table of all networked variables.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints all NWVars that exist for Player 1.</description>
	<code>PrintTable( Entity(1):GetNWVarTable() )</code>
	<output>
```
UserGroup	=	owner
```
</output>

</example>
